card.text: A 2.39-Earth-radius planet with a 13.67-day year in HD 110067's resonant chain.

introduction.text: HD 110067 c is one of six transiting sub-Neptunes. Its radius is 2.388 Earth radii and its year lasts 13.67 days.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the measured radius. Neutral gray marks the unknown surface colour; lighting comes from the host star.
